rules.title: Rules
rules.lede: Short, and the same for everyone.
rules.r1: Make your own. Any genre is fine. Don't copy another game's characters, names, levels, logos, art or music.
rules.r2: Only use pictures you may use. A picture you add only sets colours and mood.
rules.r3: Keep it decent. Nothing sexual, hateful or illegal, and no real people without their OK.
rules.r4: No scams. Never ask players for keys, passwords or money outside Flyverse.
rules.r5: Play fair. No fake plays, likes, reviews or scores. Jam results that were cheated don't count.
rules.r6: Publishing is public. Everyone can play your game and remix it; the remix names yours. You can unpublish any time.
rules.r7: Playing with friends connects your computers directly, so players in a room can see each other's network address.
rules.copy: Open its page, press Report and choose “It copies another game”, with a link to the original. You can also write to us on Discord or X. The team looks at it and hides games that break these rules.
rules.terms: Tips, unlocks and skins go straight to the creator's wallet, so fly.ai can't refund them. The site's Terms apply too.
rules.publish: By publishing you confirm it's your own work (no copied characters, names or levels) and follows the rules.
rules.cut: fly.ai takes {pct}% of unlocks and skins; tips go to the creator in full.
